name: CommandPalette
purpose: Container for the command palette: a panel with its own search input that keeps focus, a listbox of ComboboxItem palette rows, and a scroll region. Runs a command or jumps to a list or project. Split from B's Command widget; the caret mention list is Popover. Container, not a catalogue row; its look is not measured. Also (structure): Command palette: a 490px card near the top of the window with a search input and a list of commands.
base: shadcn Command (cmdk) root for the input and listbox. On web, a dialog-style overlay.

values.when: Centred near the top, over Scrim soft. The recorded case.
Desktop option if the palette is treated as a dialog window (undecided).

props.name: query
props.description: Filter text typed in the search input.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Controlled highlight index; index 0 on open.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Highlight callback for arrow keys and pointer.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Runs the picked row, then closes the palette.

states: open (search input focused; first row active)
scrolled (rows exceed the panel height; the list scrolls, does not clip)
role: listbox for the rows; the search input is the combobox.
keyboard: Typing filters the rows. ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the active row. Enter runs the active row and closes. Escape closes. / Escape closes via onClose. Arrow keys move the active row (cmdk; proposed). The opening shortcut is not confirmed (useAppKeyboard not read). The active row is scrolled into view. Web browser shortcuts take precedence; on desktop a global hotkey pressed while the main window is focused is handled by the main window.
platform: Web: opens from an in-app key; browser-reserved combinations cannot be used, because browser shortcuts take precedence; no global hotkey on web. Desktop: a global hotkey pressed while the main window is focused is handled by the main window and opens the palette there. / Desktop: presentation open. Web: overlay; the opening shortcut must not clash with a browser shortcut.
open: 1) Desktop: a separate window (as dialogs are) or an in-window overlay is not stated. 2) Web: whether the palette dims the window as a modal is not stated (menus never dim; the palette is dialog-like, unconfirmed). 3) Container look is not measured. 4) The reference clips rows past the panel edge; this container must scroll instead (a defect, not a state). 5) The web palette open key is not in the catalogue. / Presentation on desktop is undecided. Width is min(35rem, 100%): 490px at 14px rem (560px at 16px); top edge at y 91; max-h 60vh. Opening shortcut not confirmed.
